describes: CSV produced by the BigQuery query in docs/_ops/OVERNIGHT_20261005_MASTER/reconciliation/02_instrucoes_para_Bruno_exportar.md over the Cloud Billing standard usage cost export table (one row per cost row, plus one row per credit with row_kind='credit'). The column names are the aliases of that query; the source fields are the documented export schema.

sources.covers: source fields service.description, sku.id, sku.description, usage_start_time/usage_end_time (TIMESTAMP, hourly usage window), project.id, cost (FLOAT), currency, usage.amount, usage.unit, cost_type ('regular', 'tax', 'adjustment', 'rounding error'), credits (name, amount, type, id, full_name), invoice.month (YYYYMM)
enabling the standard export; multi-region (US/EU) datasets are backfilled from the start of the previous month, single-region datasets only from the enable date

unverified: service.description of the Gemini API (assumed 'Gemini API' or 'Generative Language API'; rows of other services are kept as out of scope)
SKU description wording for model and token direction (model via display-name aliases; 'input', 'output', 'cach' keywords)
usage.unit of token SKUs (assumed one of count/tokens/token; another unit keeps the amount but drops the quantity with an issue)
cost is a FLOAT64 in BigQuery: CAST to STRING keeps the shortest round-trip text, treated as 15 significant digits
provenance.notes: Credits are separate lines (row_kind=credit), taxes and adjustments too (cost_type). Costs may be in the billing account currency (e.g. BRL): a non-USD amount is never converted with a float rate; only tokens are compared then.

timestamps.note: The query formats TIMESTAMPs as RFC 3339 with Z (UTC).
